description: Get a task list's share link and its QR code (an SVG drawn by TaScan; no third-party QR service), and optionally send the link to one person: send.phone or send.worker_id texts it through TaScan's guarded SMS lane (recipient must be known to your org, STOP opt-outs and limits apply), send.email e-mails it. Write tier for the link; sending needs the full access level. style is reserved for saved QR styles and ignored today.

send.description: Optional: send the link to ONE recipient — { phone } or { worker_id } (text) or { email }, plus an optional message (at most 300 characters)

style.description: Reserved for saved QR styles (SR-P4c): accepted and ignored today

name: tascan_share_list
